title: ZeroSum — Money invariants
description: The checks that say whether the books are trustworthy. NOTE: the reconciliation-breaks panel the master specifies is absent because S06 does not exist yet — see infra/otel/registry.yaml 'blocked'. Its absence is recorded work, not an oversight.

panels.title: Invariant violations
panels.description: I2 per-currency sums, I3 balance-versus-changelog, I4 running balances, and clearing accounts that have not returned to zero. Any non-zero value is a critical alert. One series per invariant, so the alert can name which one broke.

panels.title: Invariant check healthy
panels.description: 1 means the invariant queries themselves failed, so the counts beside this panel are STALE. Without this, a gauge frozen at zero would read as perfect health.

panels.title: Quarantined records
panels.description: Records the apply engine could not turn into ledger entries. Each one has a row in quarantined_orders with its Kafka coordinates and a copy on the dead-letter topic. Any increase is a critical alert.

panels.title: Pipeline integrity signals
panels.description: Records received versus applied versus skipped as duplicates. A healthy redelivery shows duplicates rising while applied stays flat — that is effectively-once working, not a fault.

options.content:
**Reconciliation breaks** and **non-zero clearing balances by provider** are specified by the master for this dashboard but are **not rendered**: reconciliation metrics are owned by S06 (D06-4), which is not built. The `clearing_non_zero` invariant is counted in the panel above, but the per-provider breakdown needs S05/S06 data.

See `infra/otel/registry.yaml` → `blocked`. These panels are missing because the signals do not exist, not because the dashboard is incomplete.
